mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS below 0.5%) compresses the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises above 2.0% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A rising federal funds rate combined with high unemployment (UNRATE > 5%) indicates a recessionary environment where the Fed's tightening policy fails to prevent economic decline, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 3 months AND UNRATE > 5.0%
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises > 0.5pp in 3 months and UNRATE > 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST above 10% above 5-year average) signal a late-cycle expansion where consumer demand is peaking, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST is above 10% above its 5-year average.

mechanism_narrative: High unemployment (UNRATE above 5.0%) reflects economic weakness that typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is above 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales (RSAFS below its 12-month moving average) indicates weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when RSAFS falls below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls > 1.0% in 3 months AND HOUST falls > 1.0% in 3 months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO and HOUST both fall by more than 1.0% in 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO above 0.5% monthly growth) signals a strong supply-side expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is rising (above 0.5% monthly growth).
